subject: Marketplace demo: staging window, ops buffer & SI rehearsal
messages:
From: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace SE <aws-se@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace demo — propose 2-hour staging window + ops buffer

Hi Connor / Vanessa,

We'd love to lock a marketplace co-sell demo next week to walk through the integration flow and the listing checklist with the AWS marketplace team. Proposed slot: Tue Apr 6, 10:00–12:00 PT (90m demo + 30m staging/QA/ops buffer). Can your side confirm availability?

High-level asks from our side:
- Can you include an SI engineer for the first 30 minutes for integration verification?
- We need marketplace listing perms from AWS SE prior to the demo (publish view).
- Would like a 30-minute rehearsal the day before if possible.

Attached is a short suggested agenda (agenda_marketplace_demo.md).

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moreno
Business Lead, CloudWave Solutions

Attachments: agenda_marketplace_demo.md (text/markdown)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace SE <aws-se@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo — propose 2-hour staging window + ops buffer

Thanks Alyssa — that date works for Redwood in principle. A few quick notes:

- We can do Tue Apr 6, 10:00–12:00 PT, but recommend we treat 09:30–10:00 as an ops buffer for environment checks and to triage any cross-account IAM hiccups. That gives the demo a clean 10:00 start.
- Priyom (cc'd) will cover SI-level checks and the rehearsal; Priyom, can you commit to the 09:30 ops buffer + a 30-minute rehearsal on Mon Apr 5 at 11:00 PT?
- Vanessa, can you confirm the Marketplace SE permission ask? Alyssa — do you have the HubSpot account id and which marketplace account we should request publish access for?

I'll pencil the calendar for Tue 04/06 09:30–12:00 PT and Mon 04/05 11:00–11:30 PT rehearsal. If any conflicts, we'll rework.

Connor O'Brien
Partner SWE, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace SE <aws-se@amazon.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo — propose 2-hour staging window + ops buffer

Adding a couple operational items on the Marketplace side:

- AWS SE: we need `Listing Admin` role scoped to the listing (temporary) to verify the entitlement mapping during demo. If you can share the AWS account ID we can request the minimal permission set now.
- Recommend a 15-minute pre-demo checklist review inside the 09:30 buffer: release notes, model artifact hash, and sandbox credentials. Priyom — can you prepare runbook_v2.pdf (minor edits) and drop it in the Drive link?
- If CloudWave wants the rehearsal Mon 11:00 PT, give us 30 minutes to run through the login flow and entitlement checks.

I'll coordinate with Marketplace SE on the temporary permissions.

-Vanessa
Head of Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace SE <aws-se@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo — propose 2-hour staging window + ops buffer

Thanks — quick update from our side. Our SI lead just flagged a travel conflict on Tue afternoon; would you accept the alternate slot: Wed Apr 7, 13:00–15:00 PT (with 12:30 ops buffer)? We can still do the rehearsal Tue Apr 6 11:00–11:30 PT.

We prefer to keep the live demo in a single contiguous block to avoid forcing the SI off for travel, but can be flexible if Redwood strongly prefers Apr 6. Also: HubSpot account id is CW-4782 and the AWS account id for the listing is 123456789012.

Alyssa

Connor / team — I can shift to Wed Apr 7 12:30 PT buffer + 13:00–15:00 demo. I'll prepare the runbook_v2.pdf and include a short checklist for the rehearsal. Action items for external team: please share a sandbox API key (demo_creds_stub.txt is fine for calendar invites) and confirm any IP allowlist entries.

I've attached the updated runbook with the SI checklist and fallback steps (rollback steps if the entitlement mapping fails). Priyom

Samir K. (AWS Marketplace SE)
